completion.reason: The official dark transparent emblem is visible on the light desktop frame but has low contrast against the dark desktop theme; no supported standalone backed variant was established. A suitable first icon was not verified.

currency.basis: The live official banking homepage currently uses the asset as its mobile header logo and offers accounts, deposits and loans.

identity.basis: The official domain matches the existing cbnk.es record; the header explicitly labels the logo CBNK and footer identifies CBNK Banco de Colectivos S.A.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both sources belong to the same official website and are not independent. A third-party search result associated a 2024 trademark with the bank, but its page returned HTTP 403, so it is not treated as a verified independent observation.
uncertainties: The original dark transparent emblem may have insufficient contrast on dark theme; exact candidate and platform renders have not been assessed.

variant.basis: The official favicon shows this emblem as a standalone dark mark; its geometry is also present as original vector paths in the mobile header SVG. The SVG is a transparent lockup, not a plain-field-backed icon. This establishes a source design for a candidate, not final icon approval.

candidate.rationale: Use the original SVG as the provenance for the standalone emblem, supported by the official favicon; discard the accompanying wordmark for square-cell suitability. Check exact final presentation and contrast before acceptance.

proposal.reason: The operating bank's official site supplies an original vector containing its emblem, and its favicon displays the emblem alone. This is a possible source for the missing icon, not an approved final rendering.

sources.observation: The official bank homepage header labels this mobile SVG CBNK. The vector contains the dark #2D3F51 emblem and CBNK wordmark; the footer identifies CBNK Banco de Colectivos S.A. and the page presents banking products.
The site-referenced favicon visually displays the dark CBNK emblem alone, on transparency. This is raster context for standalone use, not the source of the vector geometry.
